name: minecart-player-ride
comment: WP-2.4b. A rail on a stone ledge (y = 62, x = -7..-3) running down a slope at x = -2 onto a flat rail at y = 61 (x = -1..7), z = 0. The player (id 0) and a minecart (id 1, on the slope) are created at t = 0, then the interact op (the ENTITY branch of Minecraft.clickMouse(1): EntityMinecart.interact, EntityMinecart.java:763-771) puts the player in the cart (Entity.mountEntity). The cart rolls down the slope and along the rail with a rider: its move is scaled by 0.75 and its friction is 0.997 instead of 0.96 (:303-306, :331-334); World.updateEntityWithOptionalForce updates the rider after it (EntityPlayer.updateRidden, Entity.updateRiderPosition). A direct hit of 1 at t = 40 only wobbles it; a hit of 5 at t = 60 breaks it: the rider is put off (riddenByEntity.mountEntity(this), :80-82), the cart dies and drops a minecart item. Only the cart and its drop are dumped (entity_state which [1, 2]): the player's own update is EntityPlayer's (WP-2.5). Not pinned here: dismounting by a second interact, after which the standing player pushes the cart through EntityLiving.collideWithNearbyEntities (WP-2.2, WP-2.5); the run ends before the drop's pickup delay runs out. rng_state every tick.
